missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Вход' is the masculine nominative subject of 'находится'. 'Справа' is an adverb of location answering where.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Вход' is the inanimate accusative direct object of 'закрыл', identical to the nominative. 'Главный' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Около входа' uses the genitive after 'около' to express proximity. 'Человек' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К входу' uses the dative after 'к' to show movement toward. 'Вместе' is an adverb of manner.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Перед входом' uses the instrumental after 'перед' to mean in front of. 'Вывеска' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'При входе' uses the prepositional after 'при' to mean upon entering. 'Билет' is the accusative object of 'показать'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'У входа' uses the genitive after 'у' to show location. 'Толпа' is the nominative subject, and 'большая' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. After 'два' the noun takes the genitive singular 'входа'. 'В здании' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Входы' is the nominative plural subject of 'были'. 'Закрыты' is the short-form passive participle agreeing in the plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Вход' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Удобный' and 'широкий' are agreeing masculine adjectives joined by 'и'.
